title: an-exemption-cites-a-ruling-or-an-impossibility
intention: An exemption written in CODE - a place where a check declines to run on something - stands only if it cites a ruling from Akien or states an impossibility. A declared exemption set at cairn/machines/exemptions/exemption_set.json lists every such site; a sieve in build_inspector reds any entry whose declared justification kind carries no resolvable evidence. The set includes itself, so narrowing it fires the check on itself.
why: Akien, 2026-09-10: 'there have not been 187 exceptions from me so agree' and 'these are all going to be disallowed unless they have a there-is-no-other-way reason.' An exemption reason CC authored is not a ruling from Akien and holds nothing back. Today nothing reads these sites at all: a check can be told to look away in a frozenset literal and no instrument ever asks why. That is Law 4 exactly - a rule that matters is enforced by physics, not policy - and until it is, it is a tracked debt.
how: (1) cairn/machines/exemptions/exemption_set.json, shaped after cairn/machines/corrosion/constraint_set.json: each entry carries id, path, description, and an explicit justification kind - 'ruling' with a decision id, or 'no-other-way' with a one-line statement of the impossibility. The set includes ITSELF as a member. (2) A sieve exemption_cites_a_ruling_or_an_impossibility in build_inspector, modelled on constraint_enforcement_holds at inspector.py:2415 including its self-reference tooth at line 2468. It resolves a 'ruling' kind through cairn/machines/corrosion/citation.ruling_covers_path - the existing resolution, not a second copy - and checks a 'no-other-way' kind carries a non-empty statement and a path that still resolves. IT NEVER READS ENGLISH TO DECIDE WHICH KIND APPLIES; the kind is declared and the sieve checks the declared kind's evidence. Deterministic Python, no LLM, because nothing in inspectors or gates is allowed to be LLM. (3) The charter beside it, proofs with teeth a hollow build could not pass, and the WATCHME probe.
falsifier: DONE when the declared set exists listing all seven measured sites plus itself; when the sieve reds an entry whose justification evidence does not resolve; and when a run over the live set names, per site, which justification it found. WRONG INTENT if all seven pass on the first run with no site changed - that would mean the predicate certifies whatever is already written, which is the hollow green the ruling exists to stop. The honest expectation is that the two empty rosters and the bus_client probe's _EXEMPT_SEGMENTS must say why out loud, because today they say nothing a machine can read. HORIZON: the probe reports site count and pass count on the beat; a set that never grows while new exemptions keep being written in code has become a museum.
traces_to: Law 4 (a rule that matters is enforced by physics, not policy - an exemption field nothing judges IS the policy this replaces). Law 9 (red is the default; there is no triage authority, and an exemption is the purest form of claimed triage authority). Law 8 (nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build could not pass - an exempted check is a proof that was told not to look).
